title: 7 Best Herbal Creams For Depression
intro: Herbal creams for depression are topical products that contain plant extracts and essential oils, designed to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of depression. These creams offer numerous benefits, including improved mood, reduced anxiety, and increased energy levels, making them a popular alternative to traditional pharmaceutical treatments. Examples of herbal creams for depression include those containing Ashwagandha, known for its adaptogenic properties and ability to reduce cortisol levels; Lavender oil, which promotes relaxation and reduces anxiety; and St. John's Wort, a natural mood elevator that has been used for centuries to treat mild to moderate depression. Additionally, other herbal creams for depression may include those containing Ginkgo Biloba, Valerian root, and Passionflower, all of which have been shown to have a positive impact on mood and mental health.

preparations.preparation_desc: Valeriana officinalis creams are a natural herbal preparation used to treat depression by promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety. The sedative and anxiolytic properties of this herbal preparation help to calm the mind and body, alleviating symptoms of depression. The bioactive constituents, including valerenic acid, valeranone, and valepotriates, contribute to its antidepressant effects by interacting with the GABA receptors in the brain, regulating the neurotransmitter balance and reducing stress. Regular use of Valeriana officinalis creams can provide numerous benefits, including improved mood, enhanced sleep quality, and increased overall well-being, making it a promising natural remedy for managing depression.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "BioMed research international", Valeriana officinalis creams for depression may be an alternative option for treatment in cases where conventional drugs are not applicable due to their side effects, low effectiveness, or inaccessibility.

preparations.preparation_desc: Hypericum perforatum creams, also known as St. John's Wort, have been traditionally used to treat mild to moderate depression due to their antidepressant properties. The bioactive constituents, including hyperforin and hypericin, help to inhibit the reuptake of neurotransmitters such as serotonin and dopamine, thereby increasing their availability and promoting a sense of well-being. The use of Hypericum perforatum creams has been associated with improved mood, reduced symptoms of anxiety and depression, and enhanced sleep quality. As a natural herbal remedy, Hypericum perforatum creams offer a range of benefits, including reduced side effects and a lower risk of dependence compared to conventional antidepressant medications.
preparations.preparation_study: According to Alternative medicine review : a journal of clinical therapeutic, Hypericum perforatum creams for depression have been identified as an effective treatment for mild to moderate depression, with the solid extracts of 300 mg or 600 mg three times a day revealing equivalent results to antidepressant drugs and a more favorable incidence of side effects.

These creams contain a range of bioactive constituents, including avenanthramides, ferulic acid, and avenacosides, which have been shown to have a calming effect on the nervous system and promote relaxation. The properties of Avena sativa creams, such as their ability to reduce inflammation and modulate the body's stress response, help to alleviate symptoms of depression by promoting a sense of calm and well-being. By using Avena sativa creams, individuals can experience benefits such as improved mood, reduced anxiety, and enhanced sleep quality, making it a valuable natural remedy for managing depression.

preparations.preparation_desc: Ginkgo biloba creams have been widely studied for their potential to treat depression, a common mental health disorder characterized by persistent feelings of sadness and loss of interest in activities. The properties of Ginkgo biloba creams that help to treat depression include their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in the brain. The bioactive constituents of Ginkgo biloba creams, such as flavonoids and terpenoids, have been shown to have a positive impact on depression by modulating neurotransmitter activity, improving mood, and reducing symptoms of anxiety. The benefits of using Ginkgo biloba creams to treat depression include improved mood, reduced symptoms of anxiety and depression, and enhanced cognitive function, making them a promising natural alternative for individuals seeking a holistic approach to managing their mental health.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Psychopharmacology bulletin", Ginkgo biloba creams for depression, a 320 mg dose of Ginkgo biloba combined with ginseng showed significant superiority to placebo in improving symptoms, specifically a benefit on the global score from the Symptom Checklist-90-revised (SCL-90-R) at Day 90.

Curcuma longa creams may help to treat depression by regulating the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis, reducing oxidative stress, and promoting neuroprotection. The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams to treat depression include improved mood, reduced symptoms of anxiety and depression, and enhanced cognitive function.
